output.reason: The linked PR [ev-4b7e4d8646f8][ev-5d8430c9090e] states the change concretely enough to write the open applicability aspect. Exposure happens when a LogQL parser stage extracts the same label name more than once from a log line, for example a JSON line like {"message": {"message": "foo"}}. Before the change, metric queries already stopped at the first value, while log queries used the later one. Now both use only the first value, so the behaviour of log queries changes and their results can differ. The changelog line [ev-d6a898e57d04] and the parser and parser-hint files in the change list [ev-f49cf77ebed6] confirm the subject is label extraction in pkg/logql/log. Exposure depends on query and log content at runtime, not on configuration, but the triggering condition itself is stated clearly.
